summary: Ambiguous merchant MCC on Ramp corporate card -> chargeback / vendor settlement mismatch (CloudCafé Ltd.)
description:
Issue summary: An employee submitted a corporate card transaction from CloudCafé Ltd. (Ramp charge ID RMP-2026-4491) which was auto-categorized with MCC 5734 (computer software) in the Ramp feed. Finance Ops expects MCC 5812 (restaurants) for CloudCafé locations used for customer dinners. Impact: Chargeback initiated by employee due to personal/meal classification mismatch; vendor settlement recorded to the wrong GL and PO. Business impact: misposted expense and potential duplicate payment reversal affecting month-end close.

Impact: 1 employee expense affected, 1 open chargeback in Ramp pending dispute, 1 vendor settlement line posted to GL 6400-Misc instead of 6100-Travel. Could affect AP reconciliation for March close if not resolved.

Environment: Production Ramp corporate card feed; accounting ledger (NetSuite) auto-post rules active; vendor master record CloudCafé Ltd. (vendor ID V-11892).

Steps to reproduce: 1) Export Ramp transaction export CSV for date 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-10. 2) Locate charge ID RMP-2026-4491 and note MCC and merchant name. 3) Compare Ramp category to vendor master MCC in NetSuite. 4) Review GL posting for AP settlement batch AP-2026-03-11.

Observed behavior: Ramp feed contains MCC 5734 -> Ramp auto-assigns expense class 'Software' -> Finance Ops auto-post rule mapped to GL 6400-Misc -> AP settlement to CloudCafé created against PO PO-33215 (Travel) but GL mismatch created reconciliation break.

Expected behavior: Merchant should be classified as Meals/Travel and map to GL 6100-Travel or be routed to expense report for per-diem. Chargeback should not be recorded as vendor settlement to cloud-cafe vendor master.

Attachments / exports available: Ramp CSV slice (attached in ticket), NetSuite AP settlement export (AP-2026-03-11.csv), screenshot of Ramp charge detail, email from employee (provided).
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10: Initial triage by Aisha — confirmed Ramp charge exists and chargeback flagged by employee. Vendor master has fallback MCC 5734 from previous vendor ingestion (likely bad mapping).
2026-03-10: Miguel requested Ramp export and AP batch; attached AP-2026-03-11 for ledger lines. Noted GL 6400 posting and PO-33215 linkage.

2026-03-11: Finance Ops (Leah W.) ran a vendor master lookup: CloudCafé Ltd. has two addresses; one uses MCC 5812 in vendor portal but vendor ID V-11892 is associated with an ingestion row that set MCC 5734. Hypothesis: vendor record merge created inconsistent MCC mapping.

2026-03-11: Reconciler script flagged mismatch between PO-33215 commodity code and resulting GL. Temporary fix attempted by creating journal JNL-2026-03-12-07 to move amount from 6400 to 6100 but reversal must await final ruling on chargeback status.

2026-03-12: Reached out to Ramp ops via support case RMP-CASE-8812 to request merchant reclassification or MCC override for future transactions. Ramp advises merchant-level MCC cannot be patched retroactively — recommend manual remap in finance ingestion pipeline or add rule to map merchant name pattern to travel category.
2026-03-12: Noted related internal ticket INT-7342 (travel expense reclassification) which contains prior mapping rules that may be reused.

Current hypothesis: vendor master data contains stale MCC due to vendor merge; ingestion pipeline applied MCC to card transaction mapping, causing incorrect GL mapping and triggering employee dispute/chargeback flow.
action_items: AP: Temporarily reverse the GL auto-post journal (JNL-2026-03-12-07) once chargeback outcome is confirmed. Owner: Miguel. Due: 2026-03-15.
Finance Ops: Add a merchant name pattern rule to Ramp ingestion to classify CloudCafé as Travel (5812). Owner: Leah W. Due: 2026-03-14.
Vendor Master: Audit CloudCafé vendor record V-11892 and reconcile duplicate addresses/merges; set canonical MCC=5812. Owner: Priya Desai. Due: 2026-03-16.
Card Ops: File dispute with Ramp/card issuer on behalf of the employee if chargeback is valid. Owner: Card Ops (cc: Miguel). Due: 2026-03-13.
Accounting: Hold AP settlement reversal until vendor response; prepare correcting journal if dispute lost. Owner: Miguel. Due: 2026-03-18.
